products.title: The Windward holdall
products.description: Vegetable-tanned hide, brass hardware, a lining you can replace. The piece the workshop is known for.

products.title: Day satchel
products.description: A structured satchel in vegetable-tanned hide. Fits a fifteen-inch laptop and closes over it — most don't.

products.title: Evening bag
products.description: A small evening bag in polished hide with a brass clasp. Cut for essentials, mended for life.

products.title: Long wallet
products.description: A slim long wallet in vegetable-tanned leather. Card slots, a note pocket, and edges burnished by hand.

products.title: Woven card wallet
products.description: A woven card wallet in supple hide. Holds a stack of cards and little else, on purpose.

products.title: Brass-buckle belt
products.description: A full-grain belt with a solid brass buckle. It darkens as you wear it and outlasts the trousers.

products.title: Brogue boot
products.description: A Goodyear-welted brogue boot in oiled hide. Resoleable, restitchable, made to be repaired.

products.title: Deck loafer
products.description: A hand-stitched deck loafer in soft leather. Barefoot-ready, salt-resistant, and easy to relast.
